editorial.blurb: Uncle Zhang is an underrated Northern Chinese gem serving authentic Northeastern cuisine with crispy, vinegary sauces and generous portions that stand out from typical American-Chinese fare.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the sweet and sour pork (老式锅包肉) for a crispy, vinegar-forward version that reviewers call the best they've had, and skip the one pot dish — ask servers for recommendations on their standout dishes instead.
signatureDishes: Sliced beef tenders and pork with spicy sauce (夫妻肺片)
Sweet and sour sliced pork with vinegar (老式锅包肉)
Glass cold noodle dish with peanut sauce
Sauteed lamb with cumin flavor and bone
